_note: Kaam-Vaani Stage 5 sample data. Every employer, listing and user created from this file is SAMPLE DATA — fictional businesses, not real jobs or people. The seed script (scripts/seed_kv_listings.py) marks every listing is_sample and labels it in the API/UI. Sample users live under the .sample TLD, which cannot receive mail. Statuses: verified listings are marked reviewed_by=seed-script; 'pending' listings stay in the admin queue for the demo; 'fake' listings must be flagged by the scam rules on seeding (the seed test asserts all five land flagged).
